t: You're on Cheapside, a street in the City of London that links St Martin's Le Grand with Poultry. St Paul's Cathedral lies to the west, and Bank Junction, with the Bank of England and Mansion House, is at the eastern end. Several well-known Londoners were born along this street. John Milton, who wrote Paradise Lost. Thomas Becket, who rose to be Archbishop of Canterbury and was murdered after his conflict with Henry II. And William Blackstone, whose Commentaries on the Laws of England became the best-known account of English common law.
